notes: Source: 2026 Tampa Bay Buccaneers Media Guide (IA item tampa-bay-buccaneers-2026-media-guide; the item 2026-buccaneers is a duplicate upload with the identical file hash). Records section = printed pages 491-509, pdf p493-511: INDIVIDUAL RECORDS (season and game lists, pdf p493-497), CAREER TOP TENS / MORE CAREER TOP TENS (pdf p505-508) and SEASON TOP TENS (pdf p508-510). PDF page = printed page + 2 (pdf p505 is printed 503). Postseason (BUCCANEERS PLAYOFF RECORDS from pdf p511, CAREER PLAYOFF LEADERS from p514), team records and opponent individual records (pdf p497-504) were not used.

through_season 2025: the tables contain 2025 entries (Baker Mayfield 2023-25, Rachaad White 2022-25, Mike Evans 2014-25, Lavonte David 2012-25, Chase McLaughlin 2025, 'Sean Tucker, at Buffalo, 11/16/25') and the 2026 guide was written after the 2025 season.

Career lists come from the CAREER TOP TENS pages (explicit ranks, 't' = tied). Season lists use the SEASON TOP TENS tables where they exist (passing yards, rushing yards, receptions, receiving yards, sacks, interceptions, tackles); the three touchdown categories have no top-ten table, so season TDs and all game lists come from the INDIVIDUAL RECORDS pages, which print '<value>, <player>, <season or opponent and date>' lines with no rank numbers (rank = competition ranking over the printed rows, ties tie=true). Where both exist I checked that the INDIVIDUAL RECORDS values agree with the top-ten table (work/agent_TB/verify_tb.py).

No separate career list ranks touchdown passes in the PASSING (YARDS) table; instead the MORE CAREER TOP TENS page has a 'TOUCHDOWN PASSES' list, used for career pass_td (kind=list). Likewise 'RUSHING TOUCHDOWNS' and 'RECEIVING TOUCHDOWNS' lists exist. The TD column of the yards tables disagrees with these lists for two players (Mayfield 95 vs 105; Godwin 41 vs 43): see the scope_notes; all values are as printed.

Two rows are flagged uncertain because the guide contradicts itself (Baker Mayfield 105 touchdown passes in the career TOUCHDOWN PASSES list vs 95 in the PASSING table and 28+41+26 in the season lines; Chris Godwin Jr. 43 receiving touchdowns in the career RECEIVING TOUCHDOWNS list vs 41 in the RECEPTIONS table and on his player page). The values are the printed ones; the next script should expect the other source to prefer 95 and 41. Career tackles also mix counting systems (see the career tackles scope_note: the guide's narrative says David's 1,714 tied Derrick Brooks for the record per StatsPass, while the list prints Brooks 2,198).

A season line with two years ('7, Donnie Abraham, 1999, 2000' in the INDIVIDUAL RECORDS interceptions list) is one printed line but two seasons; the top-ten table prints them as separate rows, which is what is used for season interceptions. The game-interceptions line 'Rondé Barber, twice, at New Orleans, 12/4/05 and at New Orleans, 12/23/01' became two rows.

Game lists: `years` = M/D/YYYY followed by the printed opponent text ('11/4/2012 at Oakland'); the guide prints M/D/YY and the two-digit year was expanded (00-30 -> 20xx, others 19xx; the franchise began in 1976). `raw` keeps the printed line. Career `years` are the printed spans (for example '1997-01, 2008', '1976-80,82-84'); Rondé keeps its accent. 'II'/'Jr.' suffixes kept. Red type in the guide marks current players and was ignored.

Aggregate lines not transcribed as rows (they name no single holder): game receptions '11, ten times, most recently by Chris Godwin, at New Orleans, 10/13/24' and '10, 29 times, most recently by Chris Godwin, at Green Bay, 12/17/23'.

Sacks and tackles carry no qualifier in this guide: no 'since 1982' note on the sack lists (Selmon 1976-84 and Logan 1979-86 careers, Selmon's 1977 season include unofficial years) and no solo/total/unofficial label on the tackle lists.

Verification: every digit was read from 200 dpi crops of the page pictures; table columns were cross-checked arithmetically (completion % = comp/att, average = yards/att, receptions or interceptions) and each INDIVIDUAL RECORDS list was compared with the matching top-ten table and with the IA OCR text of its page by script (work/agent_TB/verify_tb.py, verify_tb2.py). The guide contains the inconsistencies listed in the scope_notes (career pass_td, career rec_td, season sacks ranks 6/7).
